title: Push-forward of one oriented bi-Lipschitz piece of an integer multiplicity triple (Simon 3.6–3.7)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, R = (M, θ, ξ) an IMRep in U, G : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P L-Lipschitz, A ⊆ ℝⁿ Borel, κ > 0 with κ|a − a'| ≤ |G(a) − G(a')| on A, G differentiable with injective derivative on A, G(A) ⊆ M, ∫⁻_{G(A)} θ dHⁿ < ∞, and assume that for a.e. a ∈ A there is σ ∈ {1, −1} with J_G(a)·ξ(G(a))(β) = σ·β(DG(a)e) for all n-covectors β. Let φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be differentiable and Λ-Lipschitz, and assume either (regular) φ∘G satisfies κ'|a − a'| ≤ |φ(G a) − φ(G a')| on A for some κ' > 0 and D(φ∘G)(a) is injective for a ∈ A, or (critical) D(φ∘G)(a) is not injective for any a ∈ A. Then there are a Borel set N ⊆ φ(G(A)) that is countably n-rectifiable, a measurable g : ℝ^P → ℤ with g ≠ 0 on N, and a strongly measurable η : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) such that for Hⁿ-a.e. y ∈ N, η(y) is a unit orientation of an approximate tangent space of N at y; ∫⁻_N |g| dHⁿ ≤ Λⁿ·∫⁻_{G(A)} θ dHⁿ; and for every strongly measurable β : ℝ^P → Λⁿ(ℝ^P), ∫_{G(A)} θ(x)·ξ(x)(β(φ(x))∘Dφ(x)) dHⁿ(x) = ∫_N g(y)·η(y)(β(y)) dHⁿ(y), where (β∘L)(v) := β(Lv_1, …, Lv_n) (compContinuousLinearMap).
